name: hs_bussing
description: Re-add high-school basic yellow-bus service (SPS currently gives HS students ORCA only) keeping all original walk zones — the official 2-mile HS walk polygons stay as-is. HS rides are modeled as a fraction of MS propensity: x0.7 all-HS (independent transit travel, esp. PM) and grades 11-12 additionally x0.5 (cars) => 0.525 x MS; user assumption, nothing calibrates it (no HS yellow-bus history).
